name: StockSnap
notes: Every image dedicated to the public domain, free even commercially.

name: The Met Open Access
notes: Around 490000 images of public-domain works, API available.

name: Smithsonian Open Access
notes: Millions of CC0 images and 2D/3D assets.

name: Art Institute of Chicago
notes: Public-domain artworks via a documented API.

name: Cleveland Museum of Art
notes: Open Access API for public-domain works.

name: NASA Images
notes: US government work, mostly public domain. Do not imply NASA endorsement, some partner media may be restricted.

name: Library of Congress
notes: Curated free-to-use sets, confirm the item is public domain.

name: Wikimedia Commons
notes: Filter to the public-domain or CC0 subset, each file states its own license.

name: Internet Archive
notes: Prelinger and other public-domain film collections, confirm per item.

name: Openverse
notes: Aggregator, filter results to CC0 or public domain before reuse.

name: Picryl
notes: Public-domain aggregator across archives, confirm per item.

name: Flickr Commons
notes: Institutional sets with no known copyright restrictions, verify per image.

name: Unsplash
notes: Free to use, but compiling or redistributing the files is prohibited. Link or download for a project, never commit to a pack.

name: Pexels
notes: Free to use, standalone redistribution of the files is prohibited.

name: Pixabay
notes: Free to use, redistributing content on a standalone basis is prohibited.

name: Coverr
notes: Free commercial use, the raw footage may not be redistributed as stock.

name: Mixkit
notes: Free use, redistributing the raw files or building a competing library is prohibited.
